waApi.title: WhatsApp API integration (Taqnyat)
waApi.subtitle: Send to parents from the official notifications number, with a “Contact the branch” button in every message that opens a chat with the student's branch number — so parents don't reply to the API number.

waApi.guideIntro: Create these four templates in the Taqnyat portal (Message Templates) with the names above, and wait for WhatsApp approval before enabling.
waApi.guideVars: Same variable order in every template: {{1}} parent name, {{2}} number, {{3}} student name (item name for lost & found), {{4}} depends on the template (noted under each text), {{5}} tracking link.
waApi.guideButton: Add a URL button named “تواصل مع الفرع” with a dynamic URL (Meta doesn't allow wa.me links directly, so the button opens a page in the system that forwards the parent to the branch chat):
waApi.confirmSend: The message will be sent now via WhatsApp API to {{phone}}. Continue?
waApi.sendFailed: Could not send via WhatsApp API.
waApi.deptNumbersHint: If a section has its own number (e.g. the British section), it is used instead of the branch number for all its students. Leave empty to use the branch number.
waApi.visitVars: {{3}} student name — {{4}} branch name. Sent after confirming the meeting for QR visits.
waApi.lostReceiptVars: {{1}} reporter name — {{3}} item name — {{4}} branch name
waApi.autoSendHint: Receipt as soon as a feedback / tech ticket / lost-item report is logged, resolution as soon as it's written (closing the tech ticket), thank-you once a branch meeting is confirmed, and handover once an item is returned. If sending fails, the reason is logged on the record and the manual send buttons remain available.
waApi.visitAutoNote: The parent will automatically get a WhatsApp thank-you after confirming.
waApi.appointmentVars: {{3}} student name — {{4}} time and branch. Sent when the principal confirms or sets another time.
waApi.tripVars: {{1}} student — {{2}} trip name — {{3}} date and time — {{4}} message (announcement, reminder, receipt accepted/rejected) — {{5}} trip page link. Same “contact the branch” button /contact/{{1}}.

slaSettings.title: Resolution time (SLA) & working hours
slaSettings.subtitle: How long feedback and tech tickets may take, and how time is counted.
slaSettings.hoursUnit: Hours are counted per the rules below. Past the deadline a record becomes overdue and is escalated automatically.
slaSettings.businessOnly: Stop counting time outside official working hours
slaSettings.businessOnlyHint: Only time between the start and end of the working day, on working days, counts. Anything arriving in the evening or on a day off starts counting at the next working day. Also applies to the resolution time shown in lists, reports and the dashboard.
slaSettings.exampleBusiness: A working day = {{perDay}} hours, so {{hours}} hours for normal feedback ≈ {{days}} working days.
slaSettings.exampleAllDay: Not enabled: every hour of a working day counts (24h); only days off are skipped.
slaSettings.appliesNote: Changes apply to new feedback and tickets, and when a deadline is recalculated after waiting for a parent. Deadlines of currently open records don't change.
slaSettings.noDaysError: Choose at least one working day.
slaSettings.hoursError: Work must end after it starts.
